text:
Asha Verma: Quick thread 11 we need a compact spec so PM/sales can promise exact migration windows and SLAs.
Ben Cho: high level: lane-based move + clear metric gates. sales asks for 'no-surprises' comms.
Rohan Patel: propose lanes: Instant (0-14d, concierge), Rolling (15-60d, self-serve), Freeze (contract-only).
Maya S: add an Opt-Out flow: customers in Rolling can pause migration once for 30 days. Freeze = readonly pin if contract flag set.
Asha Verma: core acceptance gates: perf_p95, cost_delta_pct, intent_f1_delta, safety_regression_ratio, kv_schema_ok. numbers draft below.
Ben Cho: draft numbers (Rolling): perf_p95 <= 160ms (<=256 tokens), cost_delta <= +10%, intent_f1_drop <= 2.5%, safety_ratio <= 1.2x.
Rohan Patel: Instant gets tighter: p95 <= 120ms, f1_drop <= 1.0%. Freeze has manual approval only.
Maya S: require deterministic eval harness: seeded runs + human sample 40 for open-ended outputs. Also require tokenizer checksum match.
Lars Ops: rollout config for Console UI (example snippet):
```
rollout:
  lanes:
    - name: Instant
      initial_pct: 10
      duration_hours: 24
      monitors: [latency_p95, intent_f1]
    - name: Rolling
      initial_pct: 5
      ramp_to: 25
      duration_hours: 72
      monitors: [latency_p95, eval_delta]
  auto_rollback:
    triggers: [latency_spike_20pct, eval_delta_exceed]
    fallback: family-x-compat
```
Maya S: safety gate: define critical set of 60 prompts. if high-severity flag appears in any sample -> immediate stop. also block if hallucination increases >1.3x.
Ben Cho: pin-exception policy: permanent pin allowed only with enterprise addendum and explicit "pin_lock" billing flag. else we offer soft-pin (90 days).
Asha Verma: comms cadence proposal: pre-notice 21d, reminder 7d, 72h canary notice, final 14d sunset. opt-in windows per lane documented.
Rohan Patel: telemetry ask: tag events with migration_lane, pinned_from, pinned_to, rollout_id, fallback_used. export pre/post eval snapshots for audits.
bench-bot: queued run: "migration-harness-v1" on ded-cluster-21, expected finish 5155551270
Lars Ops: preflight checklist: tokenizer checksum, kv-migration dry-run, perf smoke at 1x and 3x QPS, model param sanity check. human stop for checksum mismatch.
Maya S: incentives: Instant -> 25% credits for 60d; Rolling -> 10% for 30d. Legal needs to approve.
bench-bot: run complete: median 98ms, p95 143ms, intent_f1_drop 1.4%, safety_ratio 1.01 -> PASS for Rolling gates
Asha Verma: Nice. Owners: Rohan -> runbook + preflight scripts (PR by 5155551265), Lars -> console defaults + rollback variant, Maya -> comm templates + incentives, Ben -> pin-exception contract text.
Ben Cho: I'll draft contract clause and sample customer message. target PR this week.
Rohan Patel: I'll include k8s example for private installs and an API snippet for invoking variant.
Maya S: will coordinate marketing templates with growth and legal.
Asha Verma: plan to merge canary config tomorrow 09:00 PT if owners sign off. keep updates here. :shipit:
